reason: After the audit we went through, my maintenance and driver records are the last thing I'll hand to a company with no customers that could be gone next year. I'd stay with what I've got before I'd bet our accreditation on a brand-new outfit.
objection: If they fold or get bought out, what happens to years of maintenance and driver records an auditor could ask for? I don't know where the data sits, whether I can export all of it, or whether there'll be anyone to ring when something goes wrong.
would_change_my_mind: A few operators like mine who've used it for six months and come through an accreditation audit on it, plus a written guarantee that my data is stored in Australia and I can export the lot whenever I want, even if they shut down.
